### About

During June and July 2021 the Gathering for Open Science Hardware (GOSH) community organised a series of salon-style meetings to explore open hardware with funding institutions. The purpose of these meetings was to connect open hardware (OH) funders and broader funders of open research and to develop guidance on OH and Open Science Hardware (OScH). The following write-ups below provide a summary of what was discussed at each of the meetings.

These meetings were convened as part of the GOSH 2021-2022 Writing Workshops. You can read more about the workshops [here](https://openhardware.science/gosh-writing-sprints-2021-2022/).

These workshops were convened by GOSH community members, funded by Alfred P Sloan Foundation and coordinated by Gathering for Open Science Hardware Inc, a US-based nonprofit.
